title: Listen Live to the Broncos vs. Chiefs NFL Game on SiriusXM
summary: Catch every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
The[Denver Broncos](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/denver-broncos) and[Kansas City Chiefs](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/kansas-city-chiefs) open their 2026 seasons tonight with an AFC West showdown on[Monday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/monday-night-football-schedule-listen) , and you can listen to every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk1-BroncosChiefs) .


[Broncos vs. Chiefs Today • 8:15PM ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk1-BroncosChiefs)


The Broncos visit the Chiefs on Monday, September 14 at 8:15pm ET from Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri. Denver enters the season as the defending AFC West champion after ending Kansas City’s nine-year run atop the division.


### How to Listen to Broncos vs. Chiefs


**Date:** Monday, September 14
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri


**Broncos broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 809 (app)
**Chiefs broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 815 (app)
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio)
**Spanish-language broadcast:** Ch. 194 (car), Ch. 832 (app)


### Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the SiriusXM app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup. Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios.


The schedule of games airing on SiriusXM for Week 1 is available here:[SiriusXM.com/Sports](http://www.siriusxm.com/sports) .


Listeners can access NFL game broadcasts and the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel with SiriusXM’s most popular subscription plans, including Platinum, All Access and Music & Entertainment, as well as SiriusXM’s sports-focused subscription plan,[SiriusXM Sports Pass](http://www.siriusxm.com/siriusxmsportspass) , priced at $5 per month.
